owner_direction: Plywood is the main cleat approach. Work toward completion with simple, decisive steps. Evaluate one factory plywood leaf to remove adjacent-leaf load sharing.
material: APA Rated Sturd-I-Floor 48 oc PS 1 plywood, at least five plies, Group 1 for bearing. Stamp, thickness and condition remain unobserved.

hardware_proposal.policy: Partially threaded SAE J429 Grade5 bolts, Grade5 UNC nuts and individual existing-type washers. Retain all 100 bolt and 66 Hillman axis lines. Bolt Depot 370 verifies the lower 5.5-in Grade5, partially threaded ASME B18.2.1 product; Lg/Lb follow the retained ASME table. Twelve existing-type spacers overall, including four unchanged front stacks. Catalog identity is not delivered-part inspection.

design_basis.local_bore_reference: Fe times minimum full-body diameter divided by five is a conservative material-reference screen, not a published whole mixed-joint ASD equation.
design_basis.metal_reference: Report elastic stresses against recorded Grade5 minimum yield and a separate divisor-two engineering reference. These are supplied-action stress comparisons, not a code qualification of a general mixed joint.

action_scope: Use each complete saved predecessor wrench at its original world location and transport it to the proposed section or bearing midpoint. The 4x6-post/current plywood force response, additional material weight and physical compatibility are not inherited.
